text_block_list.text: During lunch break, as I was walking through the school building—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm~♪ Yukippe's chocolate is delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. The chocolate Maya-chan gave me
was super delicious too~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The wrapping and the presentation were so sparkly!
Where'd ya even find chocolate like that?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Maya is a grown woman, after all!
I can spot trendy spots in no time☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa~...! It's a "City Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Whenever you're lost while shopping,
just leave it to Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Trainer-chan!
Yoo-hoo☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi, couldn't wait for Maya's chocolates?
Jeez, you're hopeless~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
See ya later, Yukippe!
Maya's got grown-up stuff to do now☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-A... Grown-up time!?
W-W-What are you gonna do to meee!?
Nothing should be going on... but before I can clear up the misunderstanding with Yukino Bijin, Mayano Top Gun drags me away...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Here you go! It's chocolate from Maya.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hurry, hurry, open it up~☆

Under her expectant gaze, I open the package she gave me.
Inside was—
"...It was packed full to bursting with chocolate."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The star one you bought at the department store, right? And the heart one's from the specialty shop in the station!
choice_data_list: You bought a ton of stuff, huh?
You bought a ton of stuff, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Maya went around to all
sorts of shops all by herself just for this day!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: L-i-k-e I said...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"In return, you have to go on a date with Maya
worth every bite of this chocolate! ♪"

And on this day, as Mayano Top Gun requested,
we went out to a specialty chocolate shop.

...It was a simple, rustic chocolate cupcake
with a distinctly homemade touch.

"Though some of the chocolates overflowed from their cups,
every single one was made with heartfelt care—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Trainer-chan.
You have to say that *after* you eat it too, okay?☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi, it's a special Maya cake
that you can't buy in any store!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...It's really special, you know?
That day was spent eating slightly overly sweet chocolate cupcakes.
